Sunday, August 23, 2026 Daily Digest

OpenAI Gains on Anthropic, The 52-Point Data Gap, Structured Data Is the New Homepage

Today's top stories in AI + enterprise tech

1

OpenAI Gains on Anthropic with Business Users

New Ramp data reveals enterprise AI spend is more volatile than expected. Anthropic leads with 44% market share among business users, but OpenAI is closing fast in Q3 — fueled by GPT-5.6 Sol adoption. The takeaway for vendors: enterprise AI loyalty is fleeting. Businesses flip between labs as new models drop.

Read on TechCrunch →
2

96% Use AI — But Only 44% Have the Data Infrastructure

The contradiction keeps widening. New survey data from Demand Gen Report and Adobe shows nearly every B2B marketer runs AI tools, but fewer than half say their data quality is adequate. The problem isn't the tools — it's the plumbing. Without unified data architecture, AI outputs remain unreliable.

Read on MarketScale →
3

Structured Data Is the New Homepage

AI agents now handle top-to-middle-funnel discovery in B2B. When a buyer asks an agent to compare enterprise platforms, it reads structured data — not your website. If your technical docs aren't machine-parseable, you're invisible. MarTech calls this "a fundamental redefinition of how brands and buyers interact."

Read on MarketScale →
4

What Actually Matters in B2B Marketing After AI?

If AI commoditizes execution — content, targeting, campaign creation — where does differentiation live? A new B2B Marketing Futures podcast episode argues the scarce thing shifts from production to judgment, positioning, and distribution. Worth 30 minutes if you're rethinking your team's focus.

Listen on Adzact →
5

AI in B2B Marketing Must Now Prove Commercial Value

TechRadar's take: experimentation phase is over. Organizations turned to AI to automate tasks, analyze data, and support content creation. Now the conversation shifts to measurable ROI. The teams that connected AI to revenue outcomes early are pulling ahead — while others get stuck in perpetual pilot mode.

Read on TechRadar →

💡 My Take

Read this one: The "structured data is the new homepage" piece. It crystallizes something most B2B teams haven't internalized yet — AI agents bypass your website entirely. They read API docs, structured specs, and machine-parseable data. If your go-to-market depends on humans browsing landing pages, you're building for yesterday's buyer journey.
